claims: You can run Claude Code free with almost unlimited usage on non-Claude models
A GitHub list names 16 companies giving AI models away for free; it has 8,400 stars
When one model hits its limit Manifest jumps to the next one
Catch: they are not Claude, so save them for small jobs
how_to_steps: Collect free API keys from the providers in mnfst/awesome-free-llm-apis
Paste the free keys into Manifest
Point Claude Code at Manifest's endpoint
Use it for small/quick-fix tasks; Manifest fails over Gemini -> GLM -> Kimi as limits hit
on_screen_only: 'Keep coding after your Claude limit hits'; Gemini / Z (GLM) / Kimi logos around 'Free models'
Diagram: Manifest -> Gemini key / Kimi key / GLM key / Claude Code
'YOUR REQUEST -> MANIFEST -> GEMINI (LIMIT HIT) / GLM (NEXT MODEL)'
'QUICK FIXES'; repo cards 'mnfst / awesome-free-llm-apis 8.4K' and 'mnfst / llm-gateway 7.5K'
cta: Comment 'Beaver' for the guide with every free key link

relevance.why: Overflow capacity for trivial tasks is mildly useful, but Haji's value comes from Claude quality; liked set already has OmniRoute doing the same thing.

implement_score.why: Only if usage limits actually bite: 1-2 hours to stand up the gateway and route a 'cheap' profile. Otherwise skip; the newer Mods model-router (see nocode.joshua) is a cleaner path to the same saving.
